title: Family Standing in Heavy Snow by House, 1967 Winter Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor family snapshot taken in January 1967 showing a group bundled in winter coats standing along a cleared pathway amidst huge snowbanks. To their left is a classic two-story clapboard house with dark window shutters. Handwritten notes on the back record a massive 22-inch snowfall, reminiscent of severe weather events in the American Midwest during the winter of 1967.
